_comment: Phoebe's clarification gate. Read fresh on EVERY chat turn — a change takes effect on the next message, no restart. enabled:false bypasses the gate entirely (incident lever). A missing or malformed file means enabled, because the normal state is guarded. PH3B3_TRIAGE=off forces it off from boot and wins over this file.
_manifest: OFF by measurement, not preference. The capability manifest stopped capability questions being held, and also held EVERY other turn whenever the context was empty — the first message of any fresh conversation. Four wordings tested including one with no instruction at all; all failed identically. See manifest_enabled() in modules/triage.py for the numbers. Do not switch this on again without re-running that measurement on whatever judge is current.
_self_subject_tier: Tier 0b: a 'missing' item that names something of HERS (body, devices, hardware) is overruled rather than held — the user cannot supply it. Read fresh per turn. Default false so the before/after is measurable and so there is a live kill switch; a tier that strips a veto errs toward an invented answer when wrong. PH3B3_TRIAGE_SELF_TIER=on|off wins over this file.
